informational.note: NOT a gate: local now runs the same production pipeline as the cloud (median background, blob detection, InpaintNet gap-fill, scaling to native resolution) via TrackNetInference.track_video, so this is no longer comparing raw model output to a filtered track. What remains is the cloud's court-ROI polygon rejection, static-cluster suppression, and minimum-movement suppression (_build_shuttle_positions_dict, modal_supabase_processor.py:4073) applied on top of its own track_video output, plus the ONNX conversion and any decode differences. A divergence here is still expected, for a narrower set of reasons than before, and must not be used as a pass/fail signal.
